name: subject_pairs
description: Labelled pairs of subjects (names of things a statement is about): same or different. Hard negatives are pairs a merge must never join (differing identifiers, units, dates, names that share words). context, when present, is tenant text the pair is judged with (a definition the matcher may learn from). split halves the set by a hash of the pair: thresholds are chosen on dev and reported on both.
